contract.purpose: Explain Anchor as a private cross-device day planner and focus timer, prove its plan-to-review loop with the current build, state its data boundary, and lead to the truthful available distribution path.
contract.purposeSource: Anchor repository PROJECT_STATUS.md and the canonical Site Health project dossier
contract.canonicalPurpose: Anchor helps a person plan a realistic day, follow the current intention, and learn why the day lived differed from the day planned.
contract.audience: People moving between Mac, iPhone, and Apple Watch who want a deliberate day and useful evidence about why reality diverged from the plan.
contract.job: Understand the plan, focus, interruption-capture, and planned-versus-lived loop; verify the privacy boundary; and download the public notarized Mac beta without mistaking invite-only TestFlight for public enrollment.
contract.thesis: A quiet dark editorial system can make Anchor's real plan-to-review loop feel deliberate while current product captures and explicit lifecycle evidence keep the promise honest.
contract.system: Dark paper and charcoal fields, cobalt actions, cyan annotations, real native captures, rounded display type, fine rules, and one hand-drawn planning scene.
contract.signature: A day-planning doodle frames the real Anchor screen, followed by the same Plan, Focus, Capture, and History sequence used by the app.
contract.risk: The complete proof loop makes the mobile page long, so each chapter needs legible product evidence and the lower trust sections need distinct visual roles.

projectCheck.note: The shared factory builds and validates all eight products with 0 Astro diagnostics; each retains 19 required public surfaces and its expected internal links. Final Anchor renders were inspected at 390, 768, and 1440 pixels.

findings: Independent re-review verified that all four baseline P1 findings were resolved and scored the final design 92/100.
Residual P2: the complete mobile proof sequence remains long and some screenshot captions are necessarily small.

comprehension.reviewer: Independent fresh-visitor re-review by Harvey after audience, CTA, mobile-proof, lifecycle, and lower-hierarchy corrections

answers.product: Anchor is a private day planner and focus timer for Mac, iPhone, and Apple Watch.
answers.audience: It is for people moving between Apple devices who want a deliberate day and want to understand why reality differed from the plan.
answers.value: It protects the current block and turns divergence into useful evidence for tomorrow rather than a score.
answers.mechanism: The page demonstrates planning, focus, immediate interruption capture, and planned-versus-lived review.
answers.proof: Current native captures, verified Build 17 release evidence, explicit privacy boundaries, current lifecycle copy, and honest fit exclusions substantiate the product.
answers.nextAction: Download the public notarized Mac beta; inspect iPhone and Watch beta status as a secondary invite-only path.
